name: Toools
tagline: Discover tools and curated workflow stacks
description: Toools is a web catalog for discovering software from GitHub, Product Hunt, curated collections, and community submissions. Search and filter listings, compare documented use cases and visible popularity signals, and follow curated tool stacks for a workflow. The MIT-licensed application can be self-hosted; hosting and database costs are separate. Toools is built and maintained by the team that curates this directory.
useCases: Find software by category, platform, pricing, or source
Compare documented use cases and visible popularity signals
Choose tools for each stage of your work

reviewNotes.basis: Explicit maintainer request for a self-listing, reviewed against current repository metadata, README and MIT license.
reviewNotes.ownership: Built and maintained by the team that curates Toools.
reviewNotes.discoveryThreshold: The automatic GitHub star threshold does not apply to this explicit manual listing. Stars are the observed value, not a ranking boost.
